title: CoefficientTargetTensorInjective
statement: Let f:X -> T be separated [def-pc-morphism-conventions], F a quasi-coherent O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], U an affine open of T, and Z an affine open of Y=f inverse image U. Let g:Tprime -> U, gprime:Xprime -> X, fprime:Xprime -> Tprime form a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with f and g followed by U. Let W=gprime inverse image of the image of Z in X and B an affine open of Tprime. Put A=Gamma(U,O), R=Gamma(B,O), N=Gamma(Z,F|Y) with the A-action of [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model], and M=gprime^*F [def-pc-module-pullback]. Using coefficientSupportIso and coefficientPullbackGenerator of [lem-pc-finite-affine-cech-coefficient-comparison-map], every R-linear map c:R tensor_A N -> Gamma(B,(W -> Tprime)_*(M|W)) which sends 1 tensor s to the supported pullback-unit section is injective.

source.place: Tags 0096, 0097, 01I9, 01IA; Tag 02KG, Lemma 30.5.1 affine tensor computation

proof.text: Obtain the R-linear supported-section decoder with its formula on unit generators.

For each pure tensor r tensor s, rewrite it as r times (1 tensor s). Linearity of c and the decoder and their generator formulas show l(c(r tensor s)) = r tensor s. Tensor induction, using preservation of zero and addition, proves l composed with c is the identity. Apply the resulting left-inverse injectivity lemma.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientTarget_tensor_injective
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) [IsSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (Z : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) (hZ : IsAffineOpen Z)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι))
    (W : X'.Opens) (hW : W = g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ Z))
    (B : T'.Opens) (hB : IsAffineOpen B) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) Γ(T', B) :=
      (g.appLE ⊤ B (by simp)).hom.toAlgebra
    let N := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)).inv ≫
        ((f ∣_ U) ≫ U.toScheme.toSpecΓ).appTop).hom)).obj
          ((F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).presheafModuleCat.obj (op Z))
    let M := (pullback g').obj F
    ∀ c : (Γ(T', B) ⊗[Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)] N) →ₗ[Γ(T', B)]
        Γ((pushforward (W.ι ≫ f')).obj (M.restrict W.ι), B),
      (∀ s : N, c ((1 : Γ(T', B)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)] s) =
        (coefficientSupportIso f' M W B).inv
          (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B ≤ W)).op
            (coefficientPullbackGenerator F (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) Z g' W hW s))) →
        Function.Injective c
